subject: [PATCH v4 1/2] mm/khugepaged: Never install PMDs in uffd-minor-registered VMAs

reviews.author: James Houghton
reviews.summary:
Reviewer noted that the patch refuses to collapse too late, causing unexpected memory contents and a minor fault, and suggested that cond_install_uffd_wp_ptes() can tolerate try_to_unmap().

Reviewer James Houghton noted that the patch refuses to collapse too late, causing unexpected memory contents after collapse and failing minor-collapse tests. He suggested fixing the self-test by undoing a 'simplification' from v3->v4, which involves adding a flag to track whether pages have already been checked.

Reviewer noted that the patch refuses collapse too late and causes unexpected memory contents after collapse, specifically due to try_to_unmap()ing PTEs userspace already CONTINUE'd and replacing the page cache, resulting in MADV_COLLAPSE failing with -EINVAL
reviews.raw_body:
Oh, I must have missed this when testing the unit test
"simplification" for this v4. :( Thanks for testing it.

It looks like uffd-wp can tolerate the try_to_unmap() because
cond_install_uffd_wp_ptes() will get called in the process.

---

Thanks for explaining that, I didn't notice the try_to_unmap(). The v3
version of the selftest didn't have this problem because it only
attempted to access each page once.

The purpose of this patch is just to avoid installing PMDs; unmapping
PTEs is acceptable. I think the logic to truly prevent unmapping in
this case probably isn't worth it. Let me know if you disagree.

So I'll just go ahead with fixing the self-test, applying a diff like
this (sorry for the formatting), undoing the "simplification" from
v3->v4:

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/mm/uffd-unit-tests.c
b/tools/testing/selftests/mm/uffd-unit-tests.c
index 74ce43769e58..48435faa8bc8 100644
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/mm/uffd-unit-tests.c
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/mm/uffd-unit-tests.c
@@ -553,6 +553,7 @@ static void
uffd_minor_test_common(uffd_global_test_opts_t *gopts, bool test_col
  char c = '\0';
  struct uffd_args args = { .gopts = gopts };
  bool bad_contents;
+ int checked = 0;

  /*
  * NOTE: MADV_COLLAPSE is not yet compatible with WP, so testing
@@ -596,6 +597,7 @@ static void
uffd_minor_test_common(uffd_global_test_opts_t *gopts, bool test_col
  * The page we already touched should not be unmapped, so a
  * second userfault on it should not be generated.
  */
+     checked = 1;
  }

  /*
@@ -604,7 +606,8 @@ static void
uffd_minor_test_common(uffd_global_test_opts_t *gopts, bool test_col
  * fault. uffd_poll_thread will resolve the fault by bit-flipping the
  * page's contents, and then issuing a CONTINUE ioctl.
  */
- bad_contents = !!check_memory_contents(gopts, gopts->area_dst_alias);
+ bad_contents = !!__check_memory_contents(checked,
+         opts->nr_pages - checked, gopts, gopts->area_dst_alias);

---

Thanks, I'll fix that.

I'm actually away right now, so I'll be slow responding to feedback
and can't send a new version until next week.

Thanks for your patience, Kiryl.

2026-10-12.patch_summary: This patch prevents the installation of PMDs in VMAs that have registered for userfaultfd (UFFD) minor notifications, which can cause unexpected behavior and failures during memory collapse operations.
